name: use pool k only on every 2^k-th reseed
mechanism: spread incoming events round-robin over many pools; at the n-th reseed include pool k only if 2^k divides n; the high pools therefore accumulate for very long stretches, so however slow the true entropy trickles in, some pool eventually gathers enough unseen material to recover -- with no entropy estimation at all

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Fortuna, intended as an improvement on Yarrow algorithm' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

fails_when: recovery time is a multiple of the true entropy rate, not immediate
instances: Fortuna, intended as an improvement on Yarrow algorithm
